items.summary: Risk disposition: BLOCKED for SearchWoot public beta/full launch and any affiliate or advertising expansion; COUNSEL_REQUIRED for upstream redistribution rights and jurisdictional privacy decisions. Recommendation: keep SearchWoot private, leave rights outreach unsent, and reject new production, telemetry, research, spend, and queue admissions this cycle. Evidence: Woot documentation confirms API access, authentication, endpoints, and rate limits, but not commercial/public redistribution, storage, derivatives, caching, display, alerts, affiliate, or advertising rights; current public terms restrict collection and commercial use. Fleet compliance is technical-only: 35 pass, 20 fail, 6 unknown, including 20 banner/consent/GA4 findings and 4 privacy/terms findings. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement/attribution, and owner gates remain blocked. Ordinary reversible growth may continue only where it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks closed. Source-rights evidence confirms an access mechanism only; data-flow evidence is partial; consent/analytics evidence is partial; logs, vendor, and incident evidence remain open. No task is closed because completion evidence is missing. Exact next evidence action: attach one dated read-only bundle containing the repository/config data-flow and retention table, deployed consent and withdrawal capture, GA4 property/data-sharing and retention settings, log-field/access inventory, vendor terms or DPA status, and incident/request procedures.

Maintain the private launch gate. Do not send upstream rights outreach, enable tracking, expand notifications, add integrations, deploy, or change production until the existing evidence tasks and non-legal gates are resolved. Next evidence action is the dated read-only bundle covering rights fields, data flow and retention, consent/GA4, logs/vendors, and incident/request handling.

items.title: Maintain SearchWoot private launch gate and complete evidence bundle
items.summary: Keep SearchWoot private because upstream data rights, privacy processing, security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. This is risk triage, not legal advice or certification.
items.requested_action: Continue the four existing launch-readiness legal tasks and attach one dated read-only evidence bundle. Keep rights outreach unsent pending owner authorization and human counsel review. Permit only bounded reversible work that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries.
